name: ssh-workspace
description: Run read-only SSH diagnostics from your Linux desktop using locally saved hosts.

interface.longDescription: Check whether saved SSH hosts are reachable, identify their OS and CPU architecture, and read Linux uptime. Connections run from your Linux desktop using a native OpenSSH client and strict host-key verification. Host profiles and saved passwords are encrypted on your machine. Use the local tools to manage profiles, select an OpenSSH version, and enroll public keys or user certificates. Chat exposes only saved host aliases and read-only diagnostic results.
defaultPrompt: List saved SSH hosts in my Lab group.
Check SSH connectivity to my saved Debian host.
What are the OS, CPU architecture, and uptime of my saved Debian host?

publication.release_notes: Redesigns native settings and history with system, light, and dark appearance options. Adds a native-client dialog and keeps cache operations off the UI thread.
